_meta.indication: RYLAZE is indicated as a component of a multi-agent chemotherapeutic regimen for the treatment of acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) and lymphoblastic lymphoma (LBL) in adult and pediatric patients 1 month or older who have developed hypersensitivity to E. coli-derived asparaginase.

pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, multicenter, sequential-cohort trial with intramuscular JZP-458 administered every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday for a total of 6 doses per course.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with ALL or LBL who had developed hypersensitivity to or silent inactivation after treatment with E. coli-derived asparaginase as a component of a multi-agent chemotherapeutic regimen.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of patients with the last 72-hour nadir serum asparaginase activity (NSAA) level >=0.1 U/mL during the first course, an established surrogate endpoint.
pivotal_trials.n: 102 patients accrued (33 to Cohort 1A, 53 to Cohort 1B, 16 to Cohort 1C).
pivotal_trials.result: The observed primary endpoint (72-hour NSAA >=0.1 U/mL in at least 90% of patients) was not met in any of the three cohorts. FDA PopPK simulations projected that at least 90% would achieve/maintain NSAA >=0.1 U/mL with 25 mg/m2 IM every 48 hours (93.6%; 95% CI 92.6% - 94.6%) or 25-25-50 mg/m2 MWF (91.4%; 95% CI 90.2% - 92.7%), considered substantial evidence of effectiveness.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence >20%) were abnormal liver test, nausea, musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, infection, headache, pyrexia, drug hypersensitivity, febrile neutropenia, decreased appetite, stomatitis, bleeding, and hyperglycemia. Adverse events of special interest: hepatotoxicity in 70%, drug hypersensitivity in 24%, pancreatitis in 12%, and thrombosis in none.
target_moa: An asparagine-specific enzyme that catalyzes the conversion of L-asparagine into aspartic acid and ammonia, depleting plasma asparagine; leukemic cells with low asparagine synthetase depend on exogenous asparagine, so depletion kills them.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was held; the section was marked Not applicable.

description.text: Added a new Monday/Wednesday/Friday dosing regimen (25 mg/m2 Mon and Wed morning, 50 mg/m2 Fri afternoon)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics license application provides an additional recommended RYLAZE dosage: 25 mg/m2 intramuscularly on Monday morning and Wednesday morning, and 50 mg/m2 intramuscularly on Friday afternoon.

orphan_indication.text: Orphan Designation DRU-2020-7734 granted June 22, 2021 for treatment of pediatric and adult patients with ALL/LBL who have developed hypersensitivity to E. coli derived asparaginase treatment.

citations.quote: - Orphan Designation (DRU-2020-7734, Jazz Pharmaceuticals, Inc.) for AEC was granted on June 22, 2021, for "Treatment of pediatric and adult patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) /Lymphoblastic lymphoma (LBL) who have developed hypersensitivity to E. coli derived asparaginase treatment."

summary.text: BLA 761179 was an original standard (non-priority) review; the application was not eligible for priority review. The product had orphan drug designation and Rare Pediatric Disease Designation. Approval was based on serum asparaginase activity, an established surrogate endpoint, without an accelerated-approval or breakthrough designation.
